idea: Implement the known upper bounds as an early exit and a search guide. These are f(k²) = k (Erdős), the bound f(k²+1) ≤ k for k ≤ 13 (Halbeisen), and the Cauchy–Schwarz bound √n. When a candidate meets the bound, return immediately; otherwise spend the remaining time on the n with the largest gap between candidate and bound.
